title: Viewing predictive alerts
description: See what's likely to need attention next.

steps.text: Open the Planner tab and look at recommendations.
Alerts flag overdue, upcoming, and seasonal items.
Tap an alert to jump to the task.

tips: Alerts are based on your usage patterns and logged services.
affects: Boat Health Score, reminders, and seasonal readiness.
examples: A notice the water pump is likely due soon.
